subject: Annotate facet_wrap with time-formatted x axis

messages.author: 24cd2253f4cae0aa
messages.subject: Annotate facet_wrap with time-formatted x axis
parts:
Good Afternoon:

The first ten rows of my data frame are copied below. I've been
struggling with the probably simple concept of placing the same label
in a precise location on all five wrapped facets. I think that the
problem is my lack of understanding of the proper format for the x-
coordinate in the annotate or geom_text() commands.

Here is my terribly messy plot construction:

p<-ggplot(digestcast,
aes(hms, Ni))
p1<-p+ geom_point(aes(colour= Tech,shape=Source,size=Digestion))+
geom_hline(yintercept=0.9824625,colour="black",linetype=2)+
scale_x_datetime(major = "2 hours", format = "%H:%M")
p2<-p1+scale_colour_manual(
value=c("red","blue","orange"),
breaks=c("JC","JH","MS"),
labels=c("Jerry","Jeff","Myron"))
p3<-p2+scale_shape_manual(
value=c(16,17),
breaks=c("Check","Sample"),
labels=c("Check Std","Metal Sample")
)
p4<-p3+scale_size_manual(
value=c(2,4),
breaks=c("EA","LO"),
labels=c("EA","LO")
)
p5<-p4+facet_wrap(~Day)
p6<-p5+opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=-45, hjust=0.5))
p7<-p6+xlab('Time of Analysis (24 Hr)')+ylab('Ni (wt%)')
p7

I added the scale_x_datetime() for two reasons:

1. To explore its use
2. To try to remedy a problem I had when I added the first version of
my label.

For example, in this plot I would simply like to place the text "EA
Avg" at the position (x=7:00, y=0.95). No matter what approach I used,
including creating a data frame with the coordinates and label, either
the text would partially appear, cut off by the y=axis, and the x-axis
would change to years (1994,2014); or the plot would not be generated
at all.

I'm certain that I am overlooking some foolish error, but I have spent
hours reviewing my dog-eared copy of the ggplot2 book, and I've
searched for some guideance via this and other R-help and ggplot2-help
lists.

Any help or advice would be much appreciated.

Happy new year to all of you.

Adam
